note: Interface of the current booted kernel. A hash of this file is not conformance of a dynamically loaded runtime. Consumers pin the git SHA they actually import and test.

mutations.unknownOutcome: replay the original Idempotency-Key and body; never mint a default key
mutations.contributorTokenGrant: POST /v1/contributor-tokens is non-idempotent. Do not invent an Idempotency-Key. 201 without a JSON object is unknown, not an issued grant. The secret is returned once.

journey.positive: discover open task → assent → reserve → claim current termsVersion → submit useful bounded evidence → pass verdict → owner accept bound to verdict id → contributor reads owed IOU
journey.contributorObligationReadback: GET /v1/tasks/{id}/contributor-obligation; none|unknown|owed; accepted is not owed

verifier.injection: EARNED_WORK_VERIFIER=default|reproduction and createApp(..., { verifier }). Owner POST /verdicts with outcome remains explicit.
verifier.evidenceIntake: optional evidenceBase64 on POST /submissions; decoded bytes bounded (16384); digest/length/mediaType bound to reservation/principal/terms; host E18 verifies staged received bytes, not a fixture catalog
